The six disks of the Disks test image at 512 x 512, and the nearest blob that Determinant of Hessian finds with the defaults. A disk counts as not found when no blob lies within half its radius. With the defaults it finds 9 blobs in all, and 5 of them are not at a disk: the four single bright pixels, or false blobs. On a copy with Gaussian noise of sigma 12 it finds 9.
